name: buttons
description: A group of buttons: a wrapping row, or one fused control with data-attach.

attributes.name: data-attach
attributes.description: Fuse the buttons into one segmented control that shares borders.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between buttons when not attached.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: The width the attached members overlap by.

a11y.notes: role="group" with a name, so the set is announced as one thing. A segmented toggle sets aria-pressed on each member; a set of tabs is the tabs component, not this.
